input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: quality census: first audits of four never-audited subjects

errors.what: First Agent brief went out with SUBJECT_PATH/STRATUM placeholders unfilled; corrected with SendMessage before the agent started work

A pkill -f of the scratch fixture servers was blocked by the bracket hook because the path appeared twice in one command line, so that whole Bash call (test append + README edit) did not run; redone in a separate call
seo_title duplicated the earlier census post of the same day; check_post_frontmatter caught it locally

doc_friction.issue: Step 1 says run `sample`; `sample` then prints that today's mode is census. The track prompt does not mention modes at all, so a run following only the prompt would run a sample round as an unrecorded deviation.

Census post naming is not specified (only sample rounds get `quality-audit-round-<n>` and fix sessions `quality-fix-*`); census posts copy `quality-census-<slug>` by example, and two census posts on the same day share the obvious seo_title pattern 'Quality census <date>: N first audits', which the site build rejects as a duplicate <title>.

deviations.why: census table suggests `census --n 6`; ran --n 4 to keep the round to four parallel auditors within one session's budget and leave time for fixes
deviations.result: all four audited with validated files and three high/medium defects fixed in the same PR

notes: Mode census (quality_audit.py mode). Seed 2026-11-17-1461. Subjects: ventures/crop-insurance-coverage-calculator, ventures/git-exposure-check, ventures/shopify-a11y-evidence, research/free-f32shadow. Meeting the bar: 0 of 4 (census, not in the sampled share; sampled share unchanged at 33 of 306); finished 4 of 4. Seeded mutations caught 10 of 23. Fix PR: #16990 (this PR) fixes git-exposure-check redirect-as-safe (high), shopify-a11y-evidence record date from export timestamp (high), crop-insurance best-level and RP cap tests (2 medium untested-core; flipped-sort mutant now caught), free-f32shadow '100x unit roundoff' overclaim and stale timings. Spot-checks I re-ran myself: crop indemnityFor RP 200/80/4/120/5 -> 200 and 200/80/4/100/9 -> 480; git-exposure-check redirect fixture -> 'not exposed' exit 0 before the fix, warning exit 1 after. Local checks: run_workflow_locally --for-changes all passed except the duplicate seo_title (fixed; check_post_frontmatter ok on 5606 posts); the stale-dist check.mjs also listed a daily-brief duplicate title unrelated to this diff. Remaining open defects recorded in each subject's README Known gaps / Limitations. No owner action needed.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: four first audits of a senior reviewer's depth (~2 h each) plus three fixes with tests and a post

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
